text: Need a ride? A pabili? A padala?
No more waiting at the kanto. No more haggling. No more guessing who is driving.
Meet Fetch Gen San. Rides, pabili, pick-up and delivery. Made in Gen San, for all of Mindanao.
Book in seconds. Choose Ride, Pabili or Delivery, type where you are going, and you are done.
You choose your driver. See the real vehicle, the plate number, the rating and the price, before you book.
Fair prices, your way. Pay by the meter, or agree a fixed price in chat. Drivers set their own rates.
Everyone is verified, with a real name, mobile number and valid I D. Track your trip live, and S O S is one tap away.
Chat for free inside the app, or call with one tap, and watch your driver come to you on the map.
Pay with cash, G Cash or bank transfer. Tip your driver, rate your trip, and earn suki points for up to ten per cent off.
And just ask me. I am George, your voice assistant. Book a ride, find your driver, or play your music.
Drivers: your rates, your schedule. Go online when you want, and get paid straight to your G Cash.
Download Fetch Gen San now. On Android, iPhone, or any browser, at genestjanramirez dot com slash fetch.
Ride. Pick. Deliver. Sa Gen San!
